.github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
  pull_request:

jobs:
  quality:
    name: Quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    env:
      FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: true
      NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: https://example.supabase.co
      NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: dummy-anon-key
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: CI Workflow Contract
        run: node --test scripts/ci-workflow-contract.test.mjs

      - name: Encoding Check (Strict)
        run: npm run check:encoding:strict

      - name: Isolated Real Next Startup Attribution Acceptance
        timeout-minutes: 7
        env:
          FAOLLA_NEXT_STARTUP_ACCEPTANCE: "1"
        # Exercise the unchanged root-owned production helper trust boundary in
        # a new private copy on the disposable hosted runner, never the checkout.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$GITHUB_ACTIONS" = true
          test "$RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT" = github-hosted
          source_root="$(pwd -P)"
          node_binary="$(readlink -f "$(command -v node)")"
          npm_cli="$(readlink -f "$(command -v npm)")"
          npm_package="$(dirname "$(dirname "$npm_cli")")"
          test "$npm_cli" = "$npm_package/bin/npm-cli.js"
          test -f "$npm_package/package.json"
          fixture_root="$(sudo -n mktemp -d /root/.faolla-next-acceptance.XXXXXXXX)"
          [[ "$fixture_root" =~ ^/root/\.faolla-next-acceptance\.[A-Za-z0-9]{8}$ ]]
          test "$(sudo -n realpath "$fixture_root")" = "$fixture_root"
          test "$(sudo -n stat -c '%u:%a' "$fixture_root")" = 0:700
          sudo -n cp -R --no-preserve=ownership "$source_root/scripts" "$source_root/node_modules" "$fixture_root/"
          sudo -n cp --no-preserve=ownership "$node_binary" "$fixture_root/node"
          sudo -n cp -R --no-preserve=ownership "$npm_package" "$fixture_root/npm"
          sudo -n chmod -R go-w "$fixture_root"
          sudo -n env -i HOME=/root PATH="$fixture_root:/usr/bin:/bin" GITHUB_ACTIONS=true \
            RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT=github-hosted FAOLLA_NEXT_STARTUP_ACCEPTANCE=1 \
            "$fixture_root/node" "$fixture_root/scripts/production-maintenance-next-startup-acceptance.mjs"

      - name: Maintenance Topology Diagnostic Tests
        run: node --test scripts/check-production-maintenance-topology.test.mjs scripts/production-maintenance-topology-workflow.test.mjs scripts/check-production-maintenance-capabilities.test.mjs

      - name: Maintenance Control and Pages ACL Contract Tests
        # Full-ancestor filesystem proofs must not overlap sibling fixture creation.
        run: node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/production-maintenance-*.test.mjs scripts/maintenance-control-probe-headers.test.mjs scripts/pages-client-write-acl-migration-contract.test.mjs scripts/pages-acl-integration/run.test.mjs

      - name: Isolated PM2 6.0.14 Maintenance Transport Acceptance
        timeout-minutes: 7
        env:
          FAOLLA_PM2_REAL_ACCEPTANCE: "1"
        run: node scripts/production-maintenance-pm2-acceptance.mjs

      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint -- --quiet

      - name: Tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build

      - name: Authentication Build And HTTP Acceptance
        timeout-minutes: 3
        run: node scripts/check-auth-middleware-build.mjs && node scripts/check-auth-middleware-http.mjs

  browser:
    name: Enterprise Browser Journeys
    needs: quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.59.1-noble
      options: --user 1001
    env:
      FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: true
      NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: https://example.supabase.co
      NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: dummy-anon-key
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build

      - name: Enterprise Browser Journeys
        run: npm run test:enterprise-browser

  qr-database:
    name: QR Atomic PostgreSQL Acceptance
    needs: quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: faolla_qr_test
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          # Disposable CI-only instance, never application credentials.
          POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD: trust
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres -d faolla_qr_test"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 12
    env:
      QR_TOKEN_INTEGRATION_ALLOW_DISPOSABLE_DATABASE: "1"
      QR_TOKEN_TEST_PORT: "5432"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - name: Check PostgreSQL client
        run: psql --version
      - name: Run QR atomic database acceptance
        run: node scripts/qr-token-integration/run.mjs

  transaction-database:
    name: Order Membership PostgreSQL Acceptance
    needs: quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: faolla_transaction_test
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          # Disposable CI-only instance, never application credentials.
          POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD: trust
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres -d faolla_transaction_test"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 12
    env:
      TRANSACTION_INTEGRATION_ALLOW_DISPOSABLE_DATABASE: "1"
      TRANSACTION_TEST_PORT: "5432"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - name: Check PostgreSQL client
        run: psql --version
      - name: Run order membership atomic database acceptance
        run: node scripts/transaction-integration/run.mjs

  redemption-database:
    name: Redemption PostgreSQL Acceptance
    needs: quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: faolla_redemption_test

        ports:

        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres -d faolla_redemption_test"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 12
    env:
      REDEMPTION_INTEGRATION_ALLOW_DISPOSABLE_DATABASE: "1"
      REDEMPTION_TEST_PORT: "5432"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - name: Check PostgreSQL client
        run: psql --version
      - name: Run redemption atomic database acceptance
        run: node scripts/redemption-integration/run.mjs

  checkout-database:
    name: Checkout Context PostgreSQL Acceptance
    needs: quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: faolla_checkout_test
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          # Disposable CI-only instance, never application credentials.
          POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD: trust
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres -d faolla_checkout_test"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 12
    env:
      CHECKOUT_INTEGRATION_ALLOW_DISPOSABLE_DATABASE: "1"
      CHECKOUT_TEST_PORT: "5432"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - name: Check PostgreSQL client
        run: psql --version
      - name: Bind checkout PostgreSQL service identity
        # psql connects to the host-mapped port; PostgreSQL observes its exact
        # service-container address, not the runner's 127.0.0.1 destination.
        env:
          FAOLLA_CI_POSTGRES_SERVICE_CONTAINER_ID: ${{ job.services.postgres.id }}
        run: node scripts/ci-postgres-service-identity.mjs

      - name: Run checkout context database acceptance
        env:
          FAOLLA_CI_POSTGRES_SERVICE_CONTAINER_ID: ${{ job.services.postgres.id }}
        run: node scripts/checkout-integration/run.mjs

  pages-acl-database:
    name: Pages Client Write ACL PostgreSQL Acceptance
    needs: quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: faolla_pages_acl_test
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres

    steps:

        run: psql --version

        env:
          FAOLLA_CI_POSTGRES_SERVICE_CONTAINER_ID: ${{ job.services.postgres.id }}
        run: node scripts/ci-postgres-service-identity.mjs
      - name: Run pages client-write ACL database acceptance
        env:
          FAOLLA_CI_POSTGRES_SERVICE_CONTAINER_ID: ${{ job.services.postgres.id }}
        run: node scripts/pages-acl-integration/run.mjs

  recovery-database:
    name: Recovery Content PostgreSQL Acceptance
    needs: quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: faolla_recovery_source_test
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD: trust
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres -d faolla_recovery_source_test"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 12
    env:
      RECOVERY_INTEGRATION_ALLOW_DISPOSABLE_DATABASE: "1"
      RECOVERY_TEST_PORT: "5432"
      RECOVERY_TEST_PSQL: /usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin/psql
      RECOVERY_TEST_PG_DUMP: /usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin/pg_dump
      RECOVERY_TEST_PG_RESTORE: /usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin/pg_restore
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - name: Create empty disposable restore target
        run: createdb --host=127.0.0.1 --port=5432 --username=postgres --no-password faolla_recovery_target_test
      - name: Check PostgreSQL clients
        run: |
          /usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin/psql --version
          /usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin/pg_dump --version
          /usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin/pg_restore --version
      - name: Bind recovery PostgreSQL service identity
        env:
          FAOLLA_CI_POSTGRES_SERVICE_CONTAINER_ID: ${{ job.services.postgres.id }}
        run: node scripts/ci-postgres-service-identity.mjs

      - name: Run database dump and restore content acceptance
        env:
          FAOLLA_CI_POSTGRES_SERVICE_CONTAINER_ID: ${{ job.services.postgres.id }}
        run: node scripts/recovery-integration/run.mjs

  maintenance-ingress:
    name: Isolated Maintenance Ingress Acceptance
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 12
    env:
      FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: true
      FAOLLA_INGRESS_REAL_ACCEPTANCE: "1"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - name: Install Isolated Acceptance Tools Without Starting Services
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$GITHUB_ACTIONS" = true
          policy=/usr/sbin/policy-rc.d
          test ! -e "$policy" && test ! -L "$policy" || exit 1
          fixture_policy="$(mktemp "$RUNNER_TEMP/faolla-ci-policy.XXXXXXXX")"
          printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 101\n' > "$fixture_policy"
          policy_hash="$(sha256sum "$fixture_policy")"
          policy_hash="${policy_hash%% *}"
          cleanup_policy() {
            local status=$?
            if ! sudo -n bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; test -f "$1"; test ! -L "$1"; actual="$(sha256sum "$1")"; test "${actual%% *}" = "$2"; rm -- "$1"' -- "$policy" "$policy_hash"; then
              status=1
            fi
            rm -f -- "$fixture_policy"
            exit "$status"
          }
          sudo -n install -o root -g root -m 755 "$fixture_policy" "$policy"
          trap cleanup_policy EXIT
          sudo -n apt-get update
          sudo -n env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends nftables iproute2 iptables ebtables curl openssl nginx kmod
      - name: Initialize Bridge Netfilter Module on Disposable CI Host Only
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$GITHUB_ACTIONS" = true
          test "$RUNNER_OS" = Linux
          test "$(. /etc/os-release; printf '%s:%s' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID")" = ubuntu:24.04
          case "$(uname -r)" in 6.*) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
          sudo -n /usr/sbin/modprobe br_netfilter
      - name: Run Real Ingress Rules Only Inside New Network Namespace
        run: node scripts/production-maintenance-ingress-acceptance.mjs

  maintenance-supabase-scheduler:
    name: Isolated Supabase Scheduler Acceptance
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 12
    env:
      FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: true
      FAOLLA_SUPABASE_SCHEDULER_ACCEPTANCE: "1"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - name: Scheduler Acceptance Safety Contracts
        run: node --test scripts/maintenance-supabase-scheduler-profile.test.mjs scripts/maintenance-supabase-scheduler-acceptance.test.mjs
      - name: Real Supabase 15.8.1.085 Scheduler SQL in Owned Disposable Container
        # Runner pins image/container identities, no network/ports/host mounts,
        # synthetic credentials, and a new tmpfs cluster. No production data.
        run: node scripts/maintenance-supabase-scheduler-acceptance.mjs
